safety_policy: A successful authorization is preflight only. No catalog operation dispatches privileged or external effects in this API version.

operations.name: service.daemonize
operations.boundary: The host service manager owns process detachment, session setup and descriptor policy.

operations.name: service.lifecycle_hooks
operations.boundary: Callbacks require an owning service object, stable lifetime and serialized state transitions.

operations.name: scheduler.cron_schedule
operations.boundary: Cron syntax validation is native; timer persistence and dispatch belong to a scheduler adapter.

operations.name: logging.append
operations.boundary: A bounded SPSC record queue is native; durable journal storage and rotation require a writer.

operations.name: service.start_unit
operations.boundary: Dependency ordering is native; process creation and readiness checks require an init adapter.

operations.name: system.graceful_shutdown
operations.boundary: Shutdown sequencing, deadlines, vetoes and storage flush results must be owned by the OS.

operations.name: system.emergency_mode
operations.boundary: Recovery shell scheduling and kernel halt policy are platform responsibilities.

operations.name: device.handle_event
operations.boundary: Device identity, driver binding and node publication require a trusted device manager.

operations.name: firmware.load
operations.boundary: Image bounds and signature verification callback are native; flashing requires a signed device adapter.

operations.name: acpi.parse
operations.boundary: ACPI table length and checksum validation are native; mapping and AML execution are not.

operations.name: ai.npu_initialize
operations.boundary: NPU discovery, allocation and command submission require a device-specific driver.

operations.name: ai.tensor_matmul
operations.boundary: Tensor shape, type and storage validation are native; execution requires a CPU/GPU/NPU backend.

operations.name: ai.inference
operations.boundary: Operator dispatch, graph scheduling and tensor allocation require a concrete compute backend.

operations.name: ai.model_load_onnx
operations.boundary: ONNX protobuf parsing, opset validation and operator lowering are not implemented in this core.

operations.name: ai.private_inference
operations.boundary: Homomorphic evaluation requires a reviewed cryptographic backend and explicit key lifecycle.

operations.name: container.create
operations.boundary: Isolation-policy validation is native; namespaces, cgroups, mounts and seccomp require kernel support.

operations.name: virtualization.create_vm
operations.boundary: VM resource-profile validation is native; vCPU execution and VM exits require a hypervisor backend.

operations.name: package.install_sandboxed
operations.boundary: Manifest/signature validation is native through a verifier callback; sandbox installation is adapter-owned.

operations.name: package.install
operations.boundary: Package identity and signature validation are native; atomic deployment and rollback require a package adapter.

operations.name: build.cross_compile
operations.boundary: Target identity validation is native; tool discovery and execution belong to an argv-based toolchain adapter.
